definitions.explanation: The act of working on raw materials to change their form or properties, such as processing food, machining metal, or editing images.

examples.japanese: {木材|もくざい}を{加工|かこう}する。
この{工場|こうじょう}では{金属|きんぞく}の{加工|かこう}を{行|おこな}っている。
examples.english: This factory carries out metal processing.

examples.japanese: {写真|しゃしん}を{加工|かこう}してSNSに{投稿|とうこう}する{人|ひと}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: More and more people are editing photos and posting them on social media.

notes:
Covers a wide range of processing activities: food processing, metalworking, woodworking, and digital image editing. The word {加工|かこう}{品|ひん} (processed product) is commonly seen on food labels.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{食品|しょくひん}{加工|かこう}: food processing
・{加工|かこう}{品|ひん}: processed product
・{画像|がぞう}{加工|かこう}: image editing
・{金属|きんぞく}{加工|かこう}: metalworking
